title: Psalm 2
opening_line: Why rage the heathen? and vain things

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Why rage the heathen? and vain things
text.normalized: Why rage the heathen? and vain things
text.reading: Why rage the heathen? and vain things

text.diplomatic: why do the people mind?
text.normalized: Why do the people mind?
text.reading: why do the people mind?

text.diplomatic: Kings of the earth do set themselves,
text.normalized: Kings of the earth do set themselves,
text.reading: Kings of the earth do set themselves,

text.diplomatic: and princes are combined,
text.normalized: And princes are combined,
text.reading: and princes are combined,

text.diplomatic: To plot against the LORD, and his
text.normalized: To plot against the LORD, and his
text.reading: To plot against the LORD, and his

text.diplomatic: Anointed, saying thus,
text.normalized: Anointed, saying thus,
text.reading: Anointed, saying thus,

text.diplomatic: Let us asunder break their bands,
text.normalized: Let us asunder break their bands,
text.reading: Let us asunder break their bands,

text.diplomatic: and cast their cords from us.
text.normalized: And cast their cords from us.
text.reading: and cast their cords from us.

text.diplomatic: He that in heaven sits shall laugh;
text.normalized: He that in heaven sits shall laugh;
text.reading: He that in heaven sits shall laugh;

text.diplomatic: the Lord shall scorn them all.
text.normalized: The Lord shall scorn them all.
text.reading: the Lord shall scorn them all.

text.diplomatic: Then shall he speak to them in wrath,
text.normalized: Then shall he speak to them in wrath,
text.reading: Then shall he speak to them in wrath,

text.diplomatic: in rage he vex them shall.
text.normalized: In rage he vex them shall.
text.reading: in rage he vex them shall.

text.diplomatic: Yet, notwithstanding, I have him
text.normalized: Yet, notwithstanding, I have him
text.reading: Yet, notwithstanding, I have him

text.diplomatic: to be my King appointed;
text.normalized: To be my King appointed;
text.reading: to be my King appointed;

text.diplomatic: And over Zion, my holy hill,
text.normalized: And over Zion, my holy hill,
text.reading: And over Zion, my holy hill,

text.diplomatic: I have him King anointed.
text.normalized: I have him King anointed.
text.reading: I have him King anointed.

text.diplomatic: The sure decree I will declare;
text.normalized: The sure decree I will declare;
text.reading: The sure decree I will declare;

text.diplomatic: the LORD hath said to me,
text.normalized: The LORD hath said to me,
text.reading: the LORD hath said to me,

text.diplomatic: Thou art mine only Son; this day
text.normalized: Thou art mine only Son; this day
text.reading: Thou art mine only Son; this day

text.diplomatic: I have begotten thee.
text.normalized: I have begotten thee.
text.reading: I have begotten thee.

text.diplomatic: Ask of me, and for heritage
text.normalized: Ask of me, and for heritage
text.reading: Ask of me, and for heritage

text.diplomatic: the heathen I’ll make thine;
text.normalized: The heathen I’ll make thine;
text.reading: the heathen I’ll make thine;

text.diplomatic: And, for possession, I to thee
text.normalized: And, for possession, I to thee
text.reading: And, for possession, I to thee

text.diplomatic: will give earth’s utmost line.
text.normalized: Will give earth’s utmost line.
text.reading: will give earth’s utmost line.

text.diplomatic: Thou shalt, as with a weighty rod
text.normalized: Thou shalt, as with a weighty rod
text.reading: Thou shalt, as with a weighty rod

text.diplomatic: of iron, break them all;
text.normalized: Of iron, break them all;
text.reading: of iron, break them all;

text.diplomatic: And, as a potter’s sherd, thou shalt
text.normalized: And, as a potter’s sherd, thou shalt
text.reading: And, as a potter’s sherd, thou shalt

text.diplomatic: them dash in pieces small.
text.normalized: Them dash in pieces small.
text.reading: them dash in pieces small.

text.diplomatic: Now, therefore, kings, be wise; be taught,
text.normalized: Now, therefore, kings, be wise; be taught,
text.reading: Now, therefore, kings, be wise; be taught,

text.diplomatic: ye judges of the earth:
text.normalized: Ye judges of the earth:
text.reading: ye judges of the earth:

text.diplomatic: Serve GOD in fear, and see that ye
text.normalized: Serve GOD in fear, and see that ye
text.reading: Serve GOD in fear, and see that ye

text.diplomatic: join trembling with your mirth.
text.normalized: Join trembling with your mirth.
text.reading: join trembling with your mirth.

text.diplomatic: Kiss ye the Son, lest in his ire
text.normalized: Kiss ye the Son, lest in his ire
text.reading: Kiss ye the Son, lest in his ire

text.diplomatic: ye perish from the way,
text.normalized: Ye perish from the way,
text.reading: ye perish from the way,

text.diplomatic: If once his wrath begin to burn:
text.normalized: If once his wrath begin to burn:
text.reading: If once his wrath begin to burn:

text.diplomatic: bless’d all that on him stay.
text.normalized: Bless’d all that on him stay.
text.reading: bless’d all that on him stay.
